title: August 2026
campaignIntro: This SEO campaign is focused on strengthening Sierra Electrical’s visibility for commercial and residential electrical searches across Edmonton and surrounding service areas.
Monthly reporting tracks technical health and ranking performance while guiding the next on-page, internal-linking, and local-content priorities.
monthlyRecap: August delivered a clean technical result and meaningful ranking progress. The site maintained a perfect 100/100 on-page SEO score with no issues identified in the latest audit.
Keyword visibility improved from an average position of 15.46 to 12.11 across the tracked set, strengthening the campaign’s foundation for continued local search growth.

We also created a dedicated Careers page and published a Google Business Profile post to support the search for a new apprentice. Next, we will look for additional no-cost ways to increase reach, including relevant Facebook and Kijiji opportunities.

recap: Sierra Electrical’s August technical audit achieved a 100/100 on-page SEO score, with 162 estimated organic monthly visits, 50 organic keywords, and 286 backlinks.
The crawl reviewed 72 URLs and found zero SEO issues. With 49 successful pages, 22 redirects, no broken URLs, and one blocked page, the site is in excellent technical shape for crawling and indexing.

internalLinks.details: Compared the latest 30-day period with the previous period. Clicks increased from 26 to 49 (about 88%), while CTR improved from 0.29% to 0.58%.

Reviewed Ubersuggest keyword movement against Google Search Console data: 11 keywords moved up, 17 moved down, and 10 were unchanged. Important Edmonton electrician terms were identified for further attention.
Reviewed the 45-URL sitemap and audited page indexability. No significant Google indexing issue was identified.

Prioritized improving existing service and content pages over publishing high volumes of generic new content. Ubersuggest identified 27 existing-content opportunities and no meaningful new-content gaps.

Strengthened the Air Piping page and reviewed early performance. It is appearing for “compressed air piping” and “air piping” searches, but remains mostly around page three and needs further optimization.
Reviewed the service and category structure, retaining Electrician as the primary category and aligning Google Business Profile services with the website.

Identified homepage, residential, and commercial targeting improvements; potential keyword-cannibalization reductions; commercial load-calculation expansion; image ALT-text improvements; and a possible transactional EV charger installation page.

internalLinking.source: What Does a Commercial Electrician Do in Edmonton?

recap: Of 38 tracked keywords, 22 moved up, nine moved down, and seven held steady. Average position improved from 15.46 to 12.11, a gain of 3.35 positions.
The strongest movement was in top-10 visibility, which increased from one keyword to four. The campaign now has 10 keywords in the top 3, 24 in the top 100, and no keywords outside the top 100.

log.linksAdded: Created the H1 and introductory copy, job-requirements section, “Why Work for Sierra Electrical” content, and the heading and subheading for the application form.

recap: August work focused on identifying and strengthening the existing pages with the greatest organic-search upside, alongside developing recruitment content for Sierra’s new Careers section.

August Google Ads generated 22 conversions from $2,394.65 in spend. After shifting the campaign toward a commercial-heavy budget allocation, conversion volume declined by four compared with the previous period.

The current campaign data reinforces why the new strategy needs close monitoring: residential generated 19 conversions from $1,261.34 in spend, while commercial generated three conversions from $1,144.24. That places the current commercial cost per conversion at roughly 5.7 times the residential level.

We will continue testing the commercial-heavy approach, but if commercial lead volume and quality do not justify the added acquisition cost, we should consider returning more budget to the established residential campaign.

nextSteps: August closes with a perfect technical audit and a 3.35-position improvement in average rankings, creating a strong platform for the next phase of SEO work.
Next month, we will protect that technical baseline while expanding the on-page, internal-linking, and local-content work that supports further top-10 keyword growth.

We will also monitor the commercial-heavy Google Ads strategy closely and develop additional low-cost recruitment promotion for the Careers page, including suitable Facebook and Kijiji listings if they fit the role and audience.
